name: District of Columbia
overview: Schedule H provides refundable income-based relief to qualifying homeowners and renters.

programs.name: Homeowner and Renter Property Tax Credit (Schedule H)
programs.ageRule: All ages; more generous income eligibility at age 70+.
programs.incomeDefinition: Federal adjusted gross income of the tax filing unit.
programs.formulaSummary: Qualifying property tax, or 20% of rent, enters the income-based Schedule H worksheet.
programs.application: Attach Schedule H to D-40 or file it as a standalone claim.
eligibilityNotes: Full-year DC residence and qualifying occupancy required.
Public/tax-exempt housing and certain dependent claims are excluded.
interactions: Separate homestead and senior/disabled property-tax reductions affect the underlying owner tax bill.
programs.programYear: 2025 housing costs and income; normally filed by April 15, 2026.

sources.title: DC real-property relief, credits and deductions

programs.name: Senior Citizen or Disabled Property Owner Tax Relief
programs.ageRule: Age 65+ or qualifying disability; qualifying owner must own at least 50%.
programs.incomeDefinition: Total federal AGI of household residents excluding fair-market tenants with written leases.
programs.incomeLimits: 2025 real-property-tax relief uses 2023 household AGI below $159,750.
programs.formulaSummary: Halves qualifying liability after applicable property-tax assessment provisions.
interactions: Disabled-veteran homestead deduction cannot be combined with this relief.

programs.name: Homestead Deduction
programs.maximumBenefit: $89,850 reduction in assessed value for tax year 2025.
programs.formulaSummary: Reduces qualifying assessed value before tax is computed.
eligibilityNotes: Owner occupancy and no more than five units.

programs.name: Assessment Cap Credits
programs.ageRule: General homeowner cap; lower taxable-assessment growth cap for qualifying seniors/disabled owners.
programs.maximumBenefit: Taxable-assessment growth generally limited to 10%; qualifying senior/disabled property to 2%.
programs.formulaSummary: Credits limit tax based on prior taxable assessed value; new-owner and improvement rules apply.
programs.application: Generally automatic for property receiving required homestead/senior benefits.

researchNotes: Additional direct property-tax relief includes homestead deductions and senior/disabled relief; it is distinct from Schedule H.
20% of rent is a statutory calculation proxy, not measured economic incidence.
The direct senior/disabled owner reduction uses 2023 household AGI for tax year 2025; Schedule H uses 2025 tax-unit AGI.
